edits.label: MainZone-Other
edits.why: line 12 is the colophon 'Записано отъ чукчи Аӈанвата осенью 1897 г. на урочищѣ Сухарномъ.', a short single line inset about equally on both sides (centred), closing no. 14; it opens no paragraph, so MainZone-P does not describe it and MainZone-Other (anything the other types do not cover) does.

notes.text: Heading 'Примѣчанія къ № 14.' is already MainZone-Other; notes 1, 2, 3 (lines 26, 30, 36) each open with 'N (стр. M).' and are bands 6-8 as the ruling wants.
